## The heuristic

**An SLA is a clock with a start, a pause and a deadline, and almost every dispute is about the pause.**


_Why:_ Starts are stamped and deadlines are arithmetic — neither is easy to argue with. The pause is the only part that is a human judgement made under pressure, so that is where the disagreement, the drift and the gaming all concentrate. Design the pause carefully and most of SLA management is solved.
